sample_unit: randomly sampled YNHHS patients (plus 7,981 YNHHS and 10,635 VUMC Lp(a)-tested patients)

links.outcome: Difference between Lp(a)-tested population and other cohorts in ARISE features
links.effect: The Lp(a) tested population significantly differed from other study cohorts (UK Biobank, ARIC, CARDIA, MESA) in terms of ARISE features.
links.quote: The Lp(a) tested population significantly differed from other study cohorts in terms of ARISE features.

links.outcome: Association of positive ARISE score with elevated Lp(a) at two health systems
links.effect: Positive ARISE score associated with higher odds of elevated Lp(a) in YNHHS (OR 1.87, 95% CI 1.65-2.12) and VUMC (OR 1.41, 95% CI 1.24-1.60); association weaker at VUMC.
links.quote: A positive ARISE score was associated with significantly higher odds of elevated Lp(a) in the YNHHS (OR 1.87, 95% CI, 1.65-2.12) and the VUMC (OR 1.41, 95% CI, 1.24-1.60).

unlisted_practices: Using ML risk scores to target Lp(a) screening in EHR populations
Assessing feasibility of computing an ML score from existing EHR data

screen.reason: Retrospective EHR-based feasibility and validation study of applying a predictive machine learning tool (ARISE) for screening elevated Lipoprotein(a). Does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
